wiki.title: Dan Ugaste
wiki.extract: Daniel Jon Ugaste is a lawyer, politician and Republican member of the Illinois House of Representatives who has represented the 65th district since 2019. He has served as Assistant Minority Leader in the House since 2025. The district, located in the western Chicago metropolitan area, includes all or parts of Campton Hills, Elburn, Elgin, Geneva, Lily Lake, South Elgin, St. Charles, and Wayne.
